details:
Currently, the Additive layer is only for humanoid bones. Also, Additive animations cannot be added to the Gesture layer. Therefore, it is not possible to incorporate additive animations that can move non-humanoid bones into avatars.
I am a creator of avatar faces with bone animation and a variety of face animations. I want to incorporate facial tracking with bones into my avatar instead of blendshapes. To do this, I need to add additive animations to the gesture layer. Once that is possible, various facial motions and facial tracking can coexist. It also allows any facial animation to move smoothly and very naturally, even while facial expressions are being synchronized. In fact, I tried this on my own avatar and it moved beautifully and smoothly. However, the body display exploded, rendering it unusable.
With the advent of MetaQuestPro, I think facial motion will become more important in the future, and facial tracking with FX alone is not perfect because it cannot coexist with other facial motion. Please consider the above improvements that will dramatically increase the variation of facial expressions of avatars.
title: If you can add Additive animation to the Gesture layer, you can expand the possibilities for facial motion!
